item.title: small apartment storage ideas - A Practical Small Space Guide
item.description: Assess Your Space for small apartment storage ideas Start by pulling out a tape measure and a sheet of graph paper (or a free floor‑plan app). Sketch each room to scale—use 1 inch = 1 foot for a 10 × 12‑ft bedroom or a 12 × 15‑ft living area. Mark doors, windows, and built‑in fixtures, noting swing directions and clearance (a typical interior door needs at least 30 inches of open space).
